summary: All 6 UI-facing acceptance criteria verified via browser checks on static Batika landing page. No backend/API criteria apply (static content, no DB).

checks.name: variant-cards-display-correctly
checks.evidence: Verified diameter/price text for reguler-lipat (±98cm, Rp400.000–Rp450.000), jumbo-lipat (±105cm, Rp500.000–Rp550.000), payung-panjang (±115cm, Rp550.000–Rp600.000), payung-golf (±120cm, Rp700.000) all visible in product-variant-grid.

checks.name: five-features-visible
checks.evidence: feature-batik-tulis, feature-anti-uv, feature-anti-air, feature-anti-badai, feature-tidak-luntur all visible with matching text in spec-list section.

checks.criterion: Status ready stock dan pre-order transparan
checks.name: preorder-status-no-20-days
checks.evidence: preorder-description contains 'tergantung motif'; preorder-estimate shows '± 2 minggu'; full body text does not contain '20 hari'.

checks.name: variant-cta-whatsapp-contextual
checks.evidence: variant-whatsapp-button-jumbo-lipat href decoded contains 6285800288414, 'Jumbo Lipat', '±105 cm', 'Rp500.000–Rp550.000'; payung-golf button similarly contains variant name, diameter ±120cm, price Rp700.000.

checks.name: global-whatsapp-cta-works
checks.evidence: navbar-whatsapp-button, hero-whatsapp-button, floating-whatsapp-button all have href containing wa.me/6285800288414.

checks.name: mobile-layout-usable
checks.evidence: At 390x844 viewport, 4 variant cards stack in single column (matching x-coords, increasing y-coords), card width <=390px, price and WhatsApp button visible, floating-whatsapp-button visible.

notes: Page is static (per seed_facts), no database/API involved, so no backend pytest lane was required for these criteria. All 6 acceptance_matrix items covered by browser checks; no exploratory extras added.
